criteria.text: Measured preflight refuses missing, stale, duplicate, floating-revision, approximate-index, or mismatched semantic evidence before any provider or paid call, with no keyword fallback.

The producer uses src.rag.pipeline.search_products against temporary real PostgreSQL/pgvector, BAAI/bge-m3 at a full pinned revision, normalized 1024-dimensional embeddings, cosine distance, and no HNSW or IVFFlat index.

The protected artifact binds catalog, query-set, model revision, retrieval contract code, pgvector version, exact search mode, top-k, ordered products, and per-query digests, and is published atomically with mode 0600.
Retrieved rows and judged relevance are separate facts; relevance comes from protected qrels, and replies are never required to quote rows merely because retrieval returned them.
Protected retrieval evaluation reports per-query and aggregate Precision@3, Recall@3, nDCG@3, and forbidden-product violations, and hard per-query failures prevent evidence publication.
The client acceptance pack explicitly bounds every historical keyword-backed round for rules 8 and 9, product selection, and catalog grounding without re-baselining or changing historical scores.
Focused unit and real-pgvector integration tests cover normal, failure, and edge cases; full repository gates, process verification, and root slice acceptance pass.

Protected run evidence records artifact and report digests, catalog and query digests, model revision, exact mode, commands, file permissions, and the remaining query_source=frozen_opening limitation without tracking corpus or catalog bodies.
